title: Book Signing This Thursday in Rhinebeck
content: I’ll be doing a book signing this Thursday, Nov. 7 at 6:00 atOblong Books in Rhinebeck, New York.I expect to be signing: DINOTOPIA• COLOR AND LIGHT • IMAGINATIVE REALISM • LIFE LESSONS FROM DINOSAURS, plus we’ve got a preview copy that you can see of THE ARTIST’S GUIDE TO SKETCHING.I’ll bring along a couple original paintings and do a brief talk and Q&A. Hope to see you there!
